verses.text: Moreover Yahweh answered Job,
“Shall he who argues contend with the Almighty? He who argues with God, let him answer it.”
lines: “Shall he who argues contend with the Almighty?
He who argues with God, let him answer it.”

verses.text: Then Job answered Yahweh,
“Behold, I am of small account. What will I answer you? I lay my hand on my mouth.
lines: “Behold, I am of small account. What will I answer you?
I lay my hand on my mouth.

verses.text: I have spoken once, and I will not answer; Yes, twice, but I will proceed no further.”
lines: I have spoken once, and I will not answer;
Yes, twice, but I will proceed no further.”

verses.text: Then Yahweh answered Job out of the whirlwind,
“Now brace yourself like a man. I will question you, and you will answer me.
lines: “Now brace yourself like a man.
I will question you, and you will answer me.

verses.text: Will you even annul my judgment? Will you condemn me, that you may be justified?
lines: Will you even annul my judgment?
Will you condemn me, that you may be justified?

verses.text: Or do you have an arm like God? Can you thunder with a voice like him?
lines: Or do you have an arm like God?
Can you thunder with a voice like him?

verses.text: “Now deck yourself with excellency and dignity. Array yourself with honor and majesty.
lines: “Now deck yourself with excellency and dignity.
Array yourself with honor and majesty.

verses.text: Pour out the fury of your anger. Look at everyone who is proud, and bring him low.
lines: Pour out the fury of your anger.
Look at everyone who is proud, and bring him low.

verses.text: Look at everyone who is proud, and humble him. Crush the wicked in their place.
lines: Look at everyone who is proud, and humble him.
Crush the wicked in their place.

verses.text: Hide them in the dust together. Bind their faces in the hidden place.
lines: Hide them in the dust together.
Bind their faces in the hidden place.

verses.text: Then I will also admit to you that your own right hand can save you.
lines: Then I will also admit to you
that your own right hand can save you.

verses.text: “See now, behemoth, which I made as well as you. He eats grass as an ox.
lines: “See now, behemoth, which I made as well as you.
He eats grass as an ox.

verses.text: Look now, his strength is in his thighs. His force is in the muscles of his belly.
lines: Look now, his strength is in his thighs.
His force is in the muscles of his belly.

verses.text: He moves his tail like a cedar. The sinews of his thighs are knit together.
lines: He moves his tail like a cedar.
The sinews of his thighs are knit together.

verses.text: His bones are like tubes of bronze. His limbs are like bars of iron.
lines: His bones are like tubes of bronze.
His limbs are like bars of iron.

verses.text: He is the chief of the ways of God. He who made him gives him his sword.
lines: He is the chief of the ways of God.
He who made him gives him his sword.

verses.text: Surely the mountains produce food for him, where all the animals of the field play.
lines: Surely the mountains produce food for him,
where all the animals of the field play.

verses.text: He lies under the lotus trees, in the covert of the reed, and the marsh.
lines: He lies under the lotus trees,
in the covert of the reed, and the marsh.

verses.text: The lotuses cover him with their shade. The willows of the brook surround him.
lines: The lotuses cover him with their shade.
The willows of the brook surround him.

verses.text: Behold, if a river overflows, he doesn’t tremble. He is confident, though the Jordan swells even to his mouth.
lines: Behold, if a river overflows, he doesn’t tremble.
He is confident, though the Jordan swells even to his mouth.

verses.text: Shall any take him when he is on the watch, or pierce through his nose with a snare?
lines: Shall any take him when he is on the watch,
or pierce through his nose with a snare?
